venue.address: 3355 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109

meta.rule: A hotel passes only if the published walking time is 30 minutes or less.
meta.method: Each pair was requested from maps.google.com as a walking route between the two addresses and the minutes figure on the result panel was transcribed. The request URL is stored per row.
meta.not_done: Off-diagonal hotel-to-hotel pairs were not queried; they are absent rather than summed from other legs.
